achievements.name: Opening Fight
achievements.detail: Win the first battle in the Ancient Gardens.

achievements.name: Team Jump
achievements.detail: Team-jump off an ally to cross more ground or line up a better shot.

achievements.name: Dash Hit
achievements.detail: Dash into an enemy on your turn and damage it with the charge.

achievements.name: New Weapon
achievements.detail: Unlock a weapon on a hero's skill tree.

achievements.name: Super Effect
achievements.detail: Defeat an enemy with a super effect such as burn, freeze, or bounce.

achievements.name: No Knockouts
achievements.detail: Finish a battle without any hero falling.

achievements.name: Battle Challenge
achievements.detail: Clear an optional challenge attached to a battle.

achievements.name: Ancient Gardens
achievements.detail: Finish Ancient Gardens, the first world.

achievements.name: Sherbet Desert
achievements.detail: Clear Sherbet Desert from its first fight through its boss.

achievements.name: Spooky Trails
achievements.detail: Clear Spooky Trails and defeat the Phantom.

achievements.name: Full Roster
achievements.detail: Unlock every hero who joins the squad over the course of the story.

achievements.name: Lava Pit
achievements.detail: Win the final battle of the Lava Pit and complete the adventure.
